paper_id: Zhou et al. - 2014 - Omnidirectional Coverage for Device-Free Passive Human Detection
title: Omnidirectional Coverage for Device-Free Passive Human Detection
motivation: 现有DfP系统因TX-RX链路架构导致方向性覆盖,无法满足智能空间等场景的全向检测需求
problem_framing: 在链路中心架构下实现盘状覆盖的被动人体检测问题,分为均衡决策和方位区分两个层次
key_insight: 利用室内丰富多径效应模糊链路中心特性,通过PHY层CFR特征提取实现近乎全向的覆盖形状
method_signature: CSI幅值直方图特征+EMD距离度量+指纹/阈值双检测方案
evaluation_criteria: 误报率/漏报率/检测率/方位区分准确率/方向性指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Coverage shape is still not perfectly omnidirectional for azimuth distinction; direction along TX-RX link shows lower classification accuracy
evidence_for_taste: exploit multipath effect to blur the directional coverage
finer-grained and more effective features might ultimately contribute to a perfect disk-like coverage
thinking_moves: 将感知问题重新框架为通信问题:利用多径效应而非消除它
从理论网络覆盖模型出发寻找与实际传感器设计的差距
通过跨层信息利用(CFR而非RSSI)突破架构限制
先定义完美目标(磁盘覆盖),再逆向追溯当前障碍的物理根源
extraction_notes: Conference version referenced; journal paper extends with threshold-based method and additional validation
